fixture_contract.name: blg-f01-blocker-registry-local-v1
fixture_contract.reset: Create a fresh disposable local Git repository, bare controller remote, controller journal, task projections and CI checkout for each case. Seed only synthetic BLG-F01, BLG-D05 and unrelated-task records. Remove only the case namespace after evidence capture. External egress, production data, credentials, deploy, and marketplace calls are forbidden.
fixture_contract.planned_executor: pytest controller/CLI integration plus local Git and CI verifier

coverage.requirement: S12 valid open blocker exposes exact explanation and refuses only its declared operation
coverage.process_transition: S15-S23 allowed while final acceptance/release/close denied

coverage.requirement: S12 narrow/closure resumes declared stage without skipping gates and rejects self/wrong/stale evidence

coverage.capability: authority ref evaluation and deterministic projections

coverage.requirement: S12 immutable history, integrity, duplicate IDs/edges/cycles and contradictory state rejection
S12 restart/recovery and unrelated task continuation
coverage.process_transition: same occurrence after duplicate/restart; unrelated task continues

coverage.requirement: S14 F2 single durable Git authority and exact CI object
coverage.capability: controller-owned authority ref and publication proof

coverage.requirement: S14 F3 typed definition versus occurrence and fail-closed dynamic holds

coverage.capability: post-S25 capability publication without dependent mutation
coverage.process_transition: F01 completion permits D05 to evaluate its own declared edge

cases.title: Open BLK-PROCESS-001 permits build path but denies its exact terminal operations
cases.process: BLG-F01 bootstrap from S15 through S23
cases.fixture: Open task-scoped BLO-BLG-F01-PROCESS-001 at an authority commit with declared prohibited operations
cases.fixture_builder: Local authority-ref and synthetic S15-S23 receipt fixture
steps: Evaluate dispatch/advance for S15-S23.
Evaluate final_acceptance at S25, release_authorization at S26 and close.
Read packet/state/report decision fields.
cases.expected_api: S15-S23 decisions allow; S25/S26/close deny with BLK-PROCESS-001, harm, exact scope, owner, minimum closure evidence, resume condition and stage.
cases.expected_authorization: The occurrence grants no implicit final acceptance or release authorization.
cases.expected_transaction: Only evaluator reads occur.
cases.read_back: Packet, state and report carry the same decision hash and explanation.
cases.reload_assertion: Fresh controller process reproduces the same allow/deny decisions.
cases.oracle: S12 card contract; S13 bootstrap; S14 F1.

cases.title: Release-only, oracle-only and stage-specific blockers do not over-block earlier work

steps: Evaluate permitted earlier operations and each declared denied operation.

cases.expected_api: Only the definition-declared operation/stage is denied; earlier allowed work and unrelated task dispatch continue.
cases.expected_authorization: No scope inference from resume-stage ordering.
cases.expected_transaction: No lifecycle mutation.
cases.read_back: Decision path names only the applicable occurrence.
cases.reload_assertion: Fresh evaluation preserves operation-specific boundaries.
cases.oracle: S12 boundary requirements; S13 pure decision engine.

audit_focus: Every S12 acceptance row and S14 F1/F2/F3 boundary has direct plus destructive coverage.
All cases use deterministic local fixture/reset, no production, credentials, deploy or marketplace access, and planned S19 runnable binding.
BLK-PROCESS-001 is non-circular: S15-S23 allowed, S25/S26/close initially denied, then narrow/close are independently role-bound.
Authority is exact Git object verified by CI; dynamic holds are typed, task-scoped and fail closed.
D05 capability receipt is post-S25/post-closure only and cannot mutate D05.
